title: Parity tester acceptance probability
statement: For every $n \ge 0$ and every subset $S \subseteq \{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $f_S$ be the Boolean function that returns the parity of the coordinates indexed by $S$. The tester that samples two independent uniform Boolean strings, queries them and their coordinatewise AND, and accepts when the third answer is the AND of the first two has acceptance probability $\frac12+\left(\frac34-\frac14(-1)^{|S|}\right)2^{-|S|}$ when run on $f_S$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite subset $S$ of the $n$ coordinates
